note: Draft for testing scripts/score_reasons.py. Values follow docs/measurement (PR #36) proposals and are NOT agreed by the team. Freeze before looking at human answers (FR-08-01).
_cell_keys: 11/6 D4 decision (Kang Sunwoo): judge per service, pooling app and web. AI is sampled per platform to match the human app:web ratio.
_platform_reference: Also report per-platform cells as reference only, for platforms with at least min_humans respondents. Not counted in the verdict summary.
_gate_fixed_70: Floor check first, then fixed 70%/50% on pooled values. Definition fixed in docs/measurement/사전등록_v1.md section 2.
_main_dist: main plus distribution similarity (1 - Jensen-Shannon divergence, base 2) on reason counts. Stratified permutation test (platform as block, all humans vs all AI personas): p >= 0.05 for dist. Added in docs/measurement/사전등록_v1.1_추가.md.
_main_rank: main plus rank agreement (Spearman, average ranks for ties) on reason counts. Same permutation test with rank as the statistic. Added in docs/measurement/사전등록_v1.1_추가.md.
_coverage_target: Report only. Sample coverage per cell (Chao et al. 2014, incidence data) and respondents needed to reach this coverage.
_human_equivalent: Report only. How many humans the AI sample is worth in distribution similarity. 0 draws turns it off.
